ImageDescription.value: Former Buda Town Hall building. It is a three-façade, one-story Baroque building. Architects: Venerio Ceresola, Matthias (Matthäus?) Nepauer, 1692-1774. Medieval details. Extended U-shaped building. Three Baroque facades. Here was the Town Hall of Buda circa 160 years long, plus town hall of Budapest District I seventy years long. Monument plaque (install. 2017) inscription: ~Former Buda Town Hall was built at the beginning of the 18th century on the remains of several medieval residences and trading houses. It was extended with storey in 1741-42, and its staircase dates from 1771-72. At the east corner a Plallas Athena statue by Carlo Adami (1785), replica by Antal Károly (1964) can be see /details:its base is stone, which is 90 cm high. Pallas Athena is in a sitting position, with the coat of arms of the city of Buda in her right hand and is a bronze spear. The statue is 150 cm high limestone./. Part of the Budapest World Heritage protected architectural ensembles - 2 Szentháromság Street = 28 Tárnok Street = 21 Úri Street, Várnegyed neighborhood, District I of Budapest.
